description.value:
Cosmic force propels you in a straight line with terrifying momentum. When you Cast this Spell, you Stride up to your full Speed in a straight line. You can move through the spaces of creatures during this movement. Each creature whose space you move through must attempt a Reflex save against your spell DC.

You ignore difficult terrain during this Stride and do not trigger Reactive Strikes from creatures you move through during the Stride.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Off-Guard]{Off-Guard} until the end of your next turn.

Failure The creature is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Prone]{Prone} and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Off-Guard]{Off-Guard} until the end of your next turn.

Critical Failure The creature is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Prone]{Prone}, becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Off-Guard]{Off-Guard} until the end of your next turn, and takes 4d6 bludgeoning damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage on a critical failure increases by 2d6.
